title: I'm building a fantasy idle RPG in Godot 4 with Codex — here's the current gameplay
author: Knuckleclot
selftext:
I've been working on Fellvault, a mobile idle RPG, as a solo developer.

I'm using Godot 4 and GDScript, with Codex helping me develop the game, generate character animation poses, improve UI, and iterate on combat systems.

One of the biggest challenges has been making AI-generated sprites actually work as convincing animations rather than just moving static images around. Balancing progression has also taken quite a bit of iteration.

The game has automatic combat, active tapping, Fury abilities, equipment drops, a Forge with enhancement/evolution, and boss progression.

The video shows an early boss fight and some equipment progression. It's from a slightly older build, I'm currently improving animations, sound effects and the combat UI.

**For anyone building games with AI: how are you handling consistent 2D character animations?** That's one area I'm still trying to improve.

I'm also planning to open the iOS beta this weekend, if the latest build passes testing. Anyone interested can join the waitlist:

[https://fellvault-web.vercel.app](https://fellvault-web.vercel.app/?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=community&utm_campaign=beta_waitlist&utm_content=aigamedev_showcase)
